notablePrerequisites:
Spark Double is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Spark Double do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Spark Double.
Activate Spark Double by tapping it.
When Spark Double becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Spark Double's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
